q: How does a bank count emissions from trade finance?
title: Trade finance financed emissions
short: Trade finance falls under financed emissions, reported in Scope 3 Category 15. PCAF sets methods for asset classes such as business loans; check its current edition for trade finance. If no method applies, attribute the client's emissions by the share of its trade you financed, and explain the method.
audience: Banks and NBFCs with trade finance books

ol: Get the client's emissions, reported or estimated.
Work out the share of its trade you financed over the period.
Multiply, and give a data quality score.

p: Trade finance turns over quickly, so use an average balance for the year rather than a year-end figure.

senseible: Senseible turns a borrower's own bills and invoices into dated, fingerprinted emission records, so a lender can use measured data in place of sector averages wherever the borrower shares it.

sources.label: PCAF, Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials
